name: Neverwinter Nights 2: Enhanced Edition
description: Neverwinter Nights 2: Enhanced Edition is a singleplayer and multiplayer third-person role-playing game, an enhanced edition of 2006's Neverwinter Nights 2.

eax.problem: This is the 2025 Enhanced Edition, not the classic Neverwinter Nights 2, and it has no EAX.

notes: GOG still sells the classic edition of Neverwinter Nights 2, which supports EAX, as Neverwinter Nights 2 Complete.
